title: My 7 YEAR Dream Game Idea Is Becoming a Reality! :)
author: Old_Mortgage_4584
selftext:
I know a lot of people love to complain about AI ruining everything but i havent smiled like this in a looong time.

Finally playing the game my teenage self dreamed about back in 2019 and it feels surreal to see that old idea of this game become true. Sorry for bad quality.

What do you all think of the demo so far?

replies.author: romansamurai
replies.body:
Idea can be great. But his point is that the AI is trained on games like hollow knight. It does not create really original stuff. So even though your idea may be yours, the execution is Claude and it WILL copy games like hollow knight to execute your “dream”. That 8/ the core problem. 

I mean the art style is almost identical. If you replaced your character with Hollow Knight, nobody would probably even think twice. 

Create all the assets separately. Completely individual of the main game pipeline. Otherwise no matter what you do, Claude and CGPT will copy hollow knight and others like it.

comments.author: Gabe_The_Mage
comments.body:
Gotta love the mindless hate on AI nowadays.

Coding is such a difficult thing to learn, and building a game can feel like a full-time job. This person finally was given the opportunity to make their childhood game idea come to life, decided to share it because they were happy about their creation, and people wanna crap on it because it's AI made, or because it doesn't meet some crazy high standard.

How about letting this poor fellow share their creation. Vibe-coded or not? Because that's what AI is nowadays, an engine for creativity.

The criticism isn't warranted either. It's not like they are trying to monetize the game or claim it's not AI.
